//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Beautified Chat Client -> Config

Enable Beautified Chat Client.//: Whether Beautified Chat Client is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chatMessageFormat.//: Variables: %timestamp% = timestamp set in timestampFormat. %username% = the username of the player who sent the message. %chatmessage% = the message itself. %prefix% = the text a server puts before the username, like a rank, used with overwriteServerChatStyle.

timestampFormat.//: Example time in formats: 5 seconds past 9 o' clock in the evening. *=Default. *(HH:mm) = 21:00, (HH:mm:ss) = 21:00:05, (hh:mm a) = 9:00 PM

chatTimestampColour.//: The colour of the timestamp in the chat message. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

chatUsernameColour.//: The colour of your own username in the chat message. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

chatOtherUsernameColour.//: The colour of other players' usernames in the chat message. chatUsernameColour is used for your own. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

chatMessageColour.//: The colour of the chat message. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

chatOtherSymbolsColour.//: The colour of the other symbols from chatMessageFormat. So everything except the variables. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

overwriteServerChatStyle.//: Whether chat in a server's own format, like with ranks, is reformatted too, using the colours set here.
